lines.gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ₂ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: gauRee₂ mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਬਿਸਰੈ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਤਾਹੂ ਕਉ ਪੀਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaa kau bisarai raam naam taahoo kau peer ||
lines.translation: One who forgets the Lord's Name, suffers in pain.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਵਹਿ ਸੇ ਗੁਣੀ ਗਹੀਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: saadhasa(n)gat mil har ravahi se gunee gaheer ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Those who join the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, and dwell upon the Lord, find the Ocean of virtue. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਰਿਦੈ ਬੁਧਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaa kau guramukh ridai budh ||
lines.translation: Those Gurmukhs whose hearts are filled with wisdom,

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਕੈ ਕਰ ਤਲ ਨਵ ਨਿਧਿ ਸਿਧਿ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: taa kai kar tal nav nidh sidh ||1||
lines.translation: hold the nine treasures, and the miraculous spiritual powers of the Siddhas in the palms of their hands. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਜਾਨਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਧਨੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo jaanahi har prabh dhanee ||
lines.translation: Those who know the Lord God as their Master,

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਿਛੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਕਮੀ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: kichh naahee taa kai kamee ||2||
lines.translation: do not lack anything. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਣੈਹਾਰੁ ਪਛਾਨਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: karanaihaar pachhaaniaa ||
lines.translation: Those who realize the Creator Lord,

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਸੂਖ ਰੰਗ ਮਾਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: sarab sookh ra(n)g maaniaa ||3||
lines.translation: enjoy all peace and pleasure. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਵਸੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: har dhan jaa kai grihi vasai ||
lines.translation: Those whose inner homes are filled with the Lord's wealth

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨ ਸੰਗਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਨਸੈ ॥੪॥੯॥੧੪੭॥
lines.transliteration: kahu naanak tin sa(n)g dukh nasai ||4||9||147||
lines.translation: - says Nanak, in their company, pain departs. ||4||9||147||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: gauRee mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਰਬੁ ਬਡੋ ਮੂਲੁ ਇਤਨੋ ॥
lines.transliteration: garab bado mool itano ||
lines.translation: Your pride is so great, but what about your origins?

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਹਨੁ ਨਹੀ ਗਹੁ ਕਿਤਨੋ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: rahan nahee gahu kitano ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: You cannot remain, no matter how much you try to hold on. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬੇਬਰਜਤ ਬੇਦ ਸੰਤਨਾ ਉਆਹੂ ਸਿਉ ਰੇ ਹਿਤਨੋ ॥
lines.transliteration: bebarajat bed sa(n)tanaa uaahoo siu re hitano ||
lines.translation: That which is forbidden by the Vedas and the Saints - with that, you are in love.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਾਰ ਜੂਆਰ ਜੂਆ ਬਿਧੇ ਇੰਦ੍ਰੀ ਵਸਿ ਲੈ ਜਿਤਨੋ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: haar jooaar jooaa bidhe i(n)dree vas lai jitano ||1||
lines.translation: Like the gambler losing the game of chance, you are held in the power of sensory desires. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਨ ਭਰਨ ਸੰਪੂਰਨਾ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਿਤਨੋ ॥
lines.transliteration: haran bharan sa(n)pooranaa charan kamal ra(n)g ritano ||
lines.translation: The One who is All-powerful to empty out and fill up - you have no love for His Lotus Feet.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਉਧਰੇ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਨਿਧਿ ਮੈ ਦਿਤਨੋ ॥੨॥੧੦॥੧੪੮॥
lines.transliteration: naanak udhare saadhasa(n)g kirapaa nidh mai ditano ||2||10||148||
lines.translation: O Nanak, I have been saved, in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. I have been blessed by the Treasure of Mercy. ||2||10||148||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ₃ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: gauRee₃ mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੋਹਿ ਦਾਸਰੋ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕੋ ॥
lines.transliteration: mohi daasaro thaakur ko ||
lines.translation: I am the slave of my Lord and Master.

lines.gurmukhi: ਧਾਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਾ ਖਾਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: dhaan prabh kaa khaanaa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: I eat whatever God gives me. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਐਸੋ ਹੈ ਰੇ ਖਸਮੁ ਹਮਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: aiso hai re khasam hamaaraa ||
lines.translation: Such is my Lord and Master.

lines.gurmukhi: ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਸਾਜਿ ਸਵਾਰਣਹਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: khin mahi saaj savaaranahaaraa ||1||
lines.translation: In an instant, He creates and embellishes. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਮੁ ਕਰੀ ਜੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਭਾਵਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaam karee je thaakur bhaavaa ||
lines.translation: I do that work which pleases my Lord and Master.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੀਤ ਚਰਿਤ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਾ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: geet charit prabh ke gun gaavaa ||2||
lines.translation: I sing the songs of God's glory, and His wondrous play. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਰਣਿ ਪਰਿਓ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਵਜੀਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: saran pario thaakur vajeeraa ||
lines.translation: I seek the Sanctuary of the Lord's Prime Minister;

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਨਾ ਦੇਖਿ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਧੀਰਾ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: tinaa dekh meraa man dheeraa ||3||
lines.translation: beholding Him, my mind is comforted and consoled. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਕ ਟੇਕ ਏਕੋ ਆਧਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: ek tek eko aadhaaraa ||
lines.translation: The One Lord is my support, the One is my steady anchor.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਲਾਗਾ ਕਾਰਾ ॥੪॥੧੧॥੧੪੯॥
lines.transliteration: jan naanak har kee laagaa kaaraa ||4||11||149||
lines.translation: Servant Nanak is engaged in the Lord's work. ||4||11||149||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: gauRee mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਹੈ ਕੋਈ ਐਸਾ ਹਉਮੈ ਤੋਰੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: hai koee aisaa haumai torai ||
lines.translation: Is there anyone, who can shatter his ego,

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਸੁ ਮੀਠੀ ਤੇ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਹੋਰੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: is meethee te ihu man horai ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: and turn his mind away from this sweet Maya? ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਗਿਆਨੀ ਮਾਨੁਖੁ ਭਇਆ ਜੋ ਨਾਹੀ ਸੋ ਲੋਰੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: agiaanee maanukh bhaiaa jo naahee so lorai ||
lines.translation: Humanity is in spiritual ignorance; people see things that do not exist.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰੈਣਿ ਅੰਧਾਰੀ ਕਾਰੀਆ ਕਵਨ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਜਿਤੁ ਭੋਰੈ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: rain a(n)dhaaree kaareeaa kavan jugat jit bhorai ||1||
lines.translation: The night is dark and gloomy; how will the morning dawn? ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਭ੍ਰਮਤੋ ਭ੍ਰਮਤੋ ਹਾਰਿਆ ਅਨਿਕ ਬਿਧੀ ਕਰਿ ਟੋਰੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhramato bhramato haariaa anik bidhee kar torai ||
lines.translation: Wandering, wandering all around, I have grown weary; trying all sorts of things, I have been searching.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਭਈ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਨਿਧਿ ਮੋਰੈ ॥੨॥੧੨॥੧੫੦॥
lines.transliteration: kahu naanak kirapaa bhaee saadhasa(n)gat nidh morai ||2||12||150||
lines.translation: Says Nanak, He has shown mercy to me; I have found the treasure of the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||2||12||150||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: gauRee mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਿੰਤਾਮਣਿ ਕਰੁਣਾ ਮਏ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: chi(n)taaman karunaa mae ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: He is the Wish-fulfilling Jewel, the Embodiment of Mercy. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲਾ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ॥ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਣਿ ਸੁਖ ਭਏ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: deen daiaalaa paarabraham || jaa kai simaran sukh bhae ||1||
lines.translation: The Supreme Lord God is Merciful to the meek; Meditating in remembrance on Him, peace is obtained. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਕਾਲ ਪੁਰਖ ਅਗਾਧਿ ਬੋਧ ॥ ਸੁਨਤ ਜਸੋ ਕੋਟਿ ਅਘ ਖਏ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: akaal purakh agaadh bodh || sunat jaso kot agh khae ||2||
lines.translation: The Wisdom of the Undying Primal Being is beyond comprehension. Hearing His Praises, millions of sins are erased. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਿਰਪਾ ਨਿਧਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਇਆ ਧਾਰਿ ॥ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਲਏ ॥੩॥੧੩॥੧੫੧॥
lines.transliteration: kirapaa nidh prabh maiaa dhaar || naanak har har naam lae ||3||13||151||
lines.translation: O God, Treasure of Mercy, please bless Nanak with Your kindness, that he may repeat the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||3||13||151||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਪੂਰਬੀ₄ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: gauRee poorabee₄ mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Gauree Poorbee, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਸਰਣਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: mere man saran prabhoo sukh paae ||
lines.translation: O my mind, in the Sanctuary of God, peace is found.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਦਿਨਿ ਬਿਸਰੈ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਸੋ ਦਿਨੁ ਜਾਤ ਅਜਾਏ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaa din bisarai praan sukhadaataa so din jaat ajaae ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: That day, when the Giver of life and peace is forgotten - that day passes uselessly. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਕ ਰੈਣ ਕੇ ਪਾਹੁਨ ਤੁਮ ਆਏ ਬਹੁ ਜੁਗ ਆਸ ਬਧਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: ek rain ke paahun tum aae bahu jug aas badhaae ||
lines.translation: You have come as a guest for one short night, and yet you hope to live for many ages.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਮੰਦਰ ਸੰਪੈ ਜੋ ਦੀਸੈ ਜਿਉ ਤਰਵਰ ਕੀ ਛਾਏ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: grih ma(n)dar sa(n)pai jo deesai jiu taravar kee chhaae ||1||
lines.translation: Households, mansions and wealth - whatever is seen, is like the shade of a tree. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਨੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਸੰਪੈ ਸਭ ਮੇਰੀ ਬਾਗ ਮਿਲਖ ਸਭ ਜਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: tan meraa sa(n)pai sabh meree baag milakh sabh jaae ||
lines.translation: My body, wealth, and all my gardens and property shall all pass away.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੇਵਨਹਾਰਾ ਬਿਸਰਿਓ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਹੋਤ ਪਰਾਏ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: devanahaaraa bisario thaakur khin mahi hot paraae ||2||
lines.translation: You have forgotten your Lord and Master, the Great Giver. In an instant, these shall belong to somebody else. ||2||
